column3: “Caused to pass a proclamation” is rendered “sent a proclamation”; NASB supplies “put it.”
“Every one who remains” is rendered “every survivor,” and “where he is sojourning” as “at whatever place he may live.” “Property” is rendered “goods.”
“Encouraged in their hands” is rendered “encouraged them,” and “vessels” as “articles.” “Precious things” is rendered “valuables.”
“Vessels” is rendered “articles,” and “brought out” (the second) as “carried away.”
“On the hand of” is rendered “by the hand of”; NASB supplies “had.”
The last item is rendered “duplicates”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
“Second order” is rendered “of a second kind.”
